why_use_section.title: Why We Engineer with Shopify
why_use_section.subtitle: Shopify provides the most robust and secure infrastructure for modern, high-volume retail operations.
paragraphs: Shopify is our primary engine for both traditional and headless commerce. By utilizing its PCI-compliant hosting and battle-tested checkout process, we eliminate the security risks associated with custom payment gateways. This allows our teams to focus on creating unique user experiences and custom business logic rather than managing server uptime or patch updates.

With the introduction of Hydrogen and Oxygen, we can now build fully decoupled, headless storefronts that offer the speed of a React-based application combined with the administrative ease of the Shopify backend. This hybrid approach ensures your site is optimized for SEO and conversion while maintaining long-term architectural flexibility.
